```{r, set-up, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, dpi = 600, fig.width = 8)

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
library(qaqcmar)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(sensorstrings)
library(stringr)

source(here("functions/subchunkify.R"))

dt_options1 <- list(
      dom = 'ft',
      paging = FALSE,
      searching = FALSE,
      pageLength = 500,
      columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-center', targets = "_all"))
)

dt_options2 <- list(
      dom = 'Bft',
      paging = FALSE,
      searching = TRUE,
      pageLength = 500,
      scrollY = "500px",
      scrollX = "500px",
      columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-center', targets = "_all")),
      buttons = c('copy', 'csv')
)

region_param <- params$region_param
depl_file <- params$depl_file

grossrange_table_path <- here("nb_grossrange_thresholds.csv")

hil_table_path <- "R:/tracking_sheets/nb_water_quality_human_in_loop_tracking.xlsx"

path_out <- file.path("R:/data_branches/nb_water_quality/processed_data")

file_name <- sub(".*/", "", depl_file, perl = TRUE)

```


```{r}
#| label: apply-qc-tests
#| include: false

dat_raw <- readRDS(depl_file)

station <- unique(dat_raw$station)
depl_range <- unique(dat_raw$deployment_range)

vars <- dat_raw |> 
  ss_pivot_longer() |> 
  distinct(variable) |> 
  pull(variable)

# if sensor depth was not measured, do not run qc_test_depth_crosscheck
if("sensor_depth_measured_m" %in% vars) {
  qc_tests <- c("grossrange", "depth_crosscheck")
} else{
  qc_tests <- "grossrange"
}

# A row with a blank sensor_type applies to any sensor type (here, the user
# limits for depth and temperature); qaqcmar combines it with the
# sensor-specific rows.
grossrange_table <- read_csv(
  grossrange_table_path,
  col_types = cols(
    variable = "c", sensor_type = "c",
    sensor_rationale = "c", user_rationale = "c",
    .default = "d"
  )
)

# qc_test_human_in_loop() ignores rows for other deployments, but filtering here
# keeps the table short for the Human in the Loop Comments section below. Blank
# cells mean "any".
human_in_loop <- read_excel(
  hil_table_path, sheet = "hil_table", na = c("NA", "")
) |> 
  filter(station == !!station, depl_range == !!depl_range)


# assign flags - qc tests
dat <- dat_raw |> 
  rename(county = region) |> 
  qc_test_all(qc_tests = qc_tests, grossrange_table = grossrange_table) |>
  qc_test_human_in_loop(human_in_loop_table = human_in_loop)

if(any(str_detect(colnames(dat), "human_in_loop"))) {
  qc_tests <- c(qc_tests, "human_in_loop")
}

# assign max flag
dat <- dat |> 
  qc_assign_max_flag(qc_tests = qc_tests)

if (nrow(dat) != nrow(dat_raw)) knitr::knit_exit()

qc_tests <- c(qc_tests, "qc")

# use to make qc_summary and figures
dat_long <- dat |>
  qc_pivot_longer(qc_tests = qc_tests)

# # export
qc_summary <- dat_long |>
  qc_summarise_flags() |>
  mutate(
    station = station,
    deployment_range = depl_range
  ) |>
  select(station, deployment_range, everything()) |>
  filter(
    !(qc_test == "climatology" &
        (variable == "salinity_psu" | variable == "sensor_depth_measured_m"))
  )

#################################################################
#### EXPORT ####################################################

dat |> 
  rename(region = county) |> 
  saveRDS(paste(path_out, "qc_data", region_param, "new", file_name, sep = "/"))

#fwrite(qc_summary,
          # paste(path_out, "qc_data/qc_flag_summary.csv", sep = "/"),
          # append = TRUE)

###############################################################
###############################################################

```

```{r}
  select(-c(station, deployment_range)) |>

```

```{r}
  human_in_loop %>%
    select(-c(region, station, deployment_range)) %>%

}
```

# QC Figures

```{r} 
#| message: FALSE
#| results: asis

if("sensor_depth_measured_m" %in% vars) {

  cat('\n## depth_crosscheck\n')

  # height of figure
  n_sensor <- dat_long |>
    filter(variable == "sensor_depth_measured_m" & !is.na(value)) |>
    distinct(sensor_serial_number)
  n_sensor <- nrow(n_sensor)

  if(n_sensor == 1) h = 2.75
  if(n_sensor > 1) h = 2.75 * n_sensor

  p <- qc_plot_flags(dat_long, qc_tests = "depth_crosscheck", ncol = 1)

  subchunkify(p$depth_crosscheck, label = "depth_crosscheck", fig_height = h, fig_width = 8.5)

  qc_tests <- qc_tests[-which(qc_tests == "depth_crosscheck")]

}

for(i in seq_along(vars)){

  var_i <- vars[i]

  cat('\n##', var_i)

  for(j in seq_along(qc_tests)) {

    test_j <- qc_tests[j]

    # climatology test not applied to these variables
    if(!(test_j == "climatology" &
         (var_i == "salinity_psu" | var_i == "sensor_depth_measured_m"))) {

      if(test_j == "qc") {
         cat('\n### summary flags\n')
      } else cat('\n###', test_j, '\n')

      # subset data to variable of interest
      dat_j <- dat_long |>
        filter(variable == var_i)

      # height of figure j
      n_sensor <- length(unique(dat_j$sensor_serial_number))

      if(n_sensor == 1) h = 2.25
      if(n_sensor > 1) h = 2.25 * n_sensor

      p <- qc_plot_flags(dat_j, qc_tests = test_j, ncol = 1, flag_title = FALSE)
      
      subchunkify(
        p[[1]][[1]], 
        label = paste0(var_i, test_j),
        fig_height = h, fig_width = 8.5, dpi = 150, out_width = "100%")
    }
  }
}

```
